title: Carry forward momentum through alternating support legs.
brief: Three linked alternating bounds are the main task. Same-foot skip hops, short forward unilateral pogos, a walking-entry bound and low-hurdle alternating contacts each constrain a different part of takeoff/receive timing. A step-through chest release couples one forward weight transfer with the arms without another landing.

explosive.name: Alternating Bounds — Three Linked Contacts
explosive.job: Transfer impulse repeatedly from one support leg to the other.
explosive.cue: Begin with a single-leg push and alternate receiving feet for exactly three forward bounds; hold the last landing 2 s. Start the second set from the other leg.
explosive.regress: Shorten each bound; stop if an intermediate contact collapses or the athlete cannot control the final stop.
explosive.note: Six total landings, three on each leg across the two sets.

explosive.name: Power Skip for Distance
explosive.job: Coordinate a same-foot hop with the next stepping support before alternating projection.
explosive.cue: Perform four step-hop cycles traveling forward: land the hop on its takeoff foot, then step onto the other foot for the next hop.
explosive.regress: Shorten the hop and slow the stepping rhythm; stop if it becomes uncontrolled running bounds.
explosive.note: Four hop landings (two each leg) plus four ordinary setup/transfer steps; at most 4 m.

explosive.name: Single-leg Forward-Traveling Pogo
explosive.job: Keep a small forward-moving ankle rebound organized on each support foot.
explosive.cue: Make two low consecutive forward same-foot contacts, then settle; repeat on the other side.
explosive.regress: Reduce travel/amplitude; stop for knee locking, foot reaching or loss of rhythm.

explosive.name: Walking-entry Opposite-leg Bound to Stick
explosive.job: Receive a small amount of entry momentum before transferring to the other leg.
explosive.cue: Take one walking step onto the takeoff foot, immediately bound forward to the opposite foot and hold 2 s.
explosive.regress: Shorten/slow the entry; stop for an extra gather step or uncontrolled reach.
explosive.note: Two ordinary entry steps total; each entry at most 1 m.

explosive.name: Step-through Medicine Ball Chest Pass
explosive.job: Match forward weight transfer to a two-arm release.
explosive.cue: From a staggered stance, step the rear foot forward while driving a light ball from the chest; finish balanced without chasing the throw.
explosive.regress: Slow/shorten the step and reduce ball load; stop if the body falls through the release.
explosive.intent: Fast release with a light ball; retain the prescribed grounded support
explosive.note: Six forward step-throughs total; no athlete jump intended.

explosive.name: Alternating Bounds over Two Low Hurdles
explosive.job: Place alternating contacts around a real flight-clearance constraint.
explosive.cue: Clear two very low hurdles with two alternating forward bounds and hold the final landing; each clearance lands on the opposite foot.
explosive.regress: Lower/bring the hurdles closer while retaining comfortable alternate contacts; stop for clipping or a rushed landing.
explosive.gate: Familiar low-hurdle alternating clearance; no new maximum height.
explosive.note: Two total unilateral landings, one each leg.

control.name: Isometric Ankle Inversion Press — Self Resisted
control.job: Lightly stabilize medial foot direction during alternating stance.
control.cue: Seated, heel supported; use the opposite hand as gentle resistance while the working forefoot presses inward without turning the knee.
control.regress: Reduce pressure; stop for toe curling or ankle discomfort.
control.intent: Bodyweight/light resistance, easy control; at least 5 clean reps in reserve or comparable ease

control.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge Iso Hold
control.job: Maintain pelvic height when the other leg is not supporting the body.
control.cue: From a short-lever bridge, unload one foot and hold the pelvis level with ribs down; keep the working heel comfortably close.
control.regress: Shorten the lever and lower the hold; stop for pelvic rotation or cramp.
control.intent: Bodyweight/light resistance, easy control; at least 5 clean reps in reserve or comparable ease

strength.name: Hip Thrust — pelvic dumbbell, upper back on bench
Standing Calf Raise — hand-supported single-leg, dumbbell

decision: The main bound uses six linked contacts total, balanced across legs by changing the starting side. Other unilateral drills are deliberately small: two entry bounds and two hurdle bounds. This limits the shift toward all-single-leg landings instead of equating them with the earlier bilateral totals. The calf lift changes to a supported straight-knee version for late stance force; squat and walkout volume are reduced to keep unilateral strength productive. Strength loads remain conditional on actual capability.
next_job: Class 8 will address repeated projection from the same leg; use actual alternating-contact and recovery observations to decide whether that demand is appropriate.
